@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+# Dependency Planner
+
+A dependency-free Bun TypeScript CLI that validates a task graph and produces a deterministic execution plan.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts plan INPUT.json
+```
+
+`INPUT.json` must contain a `tasks` array. Each task needs a unique non-empty `id`, a finite non-negative `duration`, and optional `dependsOn` task ids.
+
+The command writes one JSON object to stdout with topological `order`, parallel `layers`, unlimited-parallelism `earliest` times, `totalDuration`, and a deterministic `criticalPath`. Invalid input and cycles are reported to stderr with a non-zero exit status.

13: function fail(message: string): never {
14:   console.error(`Error: ${message}`);
15:   process.exit(1);
16: }
17: 
18: function validate(value: unknown): Task[] {
19:   if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || !Array.isArray((value as { tasks?: unknown }).tasks)) {
20:     fail("input must be an object with a tasks array");
21:   }
22: 
23:   const rawTasks = (value as { tasks: unknown[] }).tasks;
24:   const tasks: Task[] = [];
25:   const ids = new Set<string>();
26: 
27:   for (const [index, raw] of rawTasks.entries()) {
28:     if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null || Array.isArray(raw)) {
29:       fail(`tasks[${index}] must be an object`);
30:     }
31:     const task = raw as Partial<InputTask>;
32:     if (typeof task.id !== "string" || task.id.length === 0) fail(`tasks[${index}].id must be a non-empty string`);
33:     if (ids.has(task.id)) fail(`duplicate task id: ${task.id}`);
34:     if (typeof task.duration !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(task.duration) || task.duration < 0) {
35:       fail(`tasks[${index}].duration must be a finite non-negative number`);
36:     }
37:     const dependsOn = task.dependsOn ?? [];
38:     if (!Array.isArray(dependsOn) || dependsOn.some((id) => typeof id !== "string")) {
39:       fail(`tasks[${index}].dependsOn must be an array of strings`);
40:     }
41:     if (new Set(dependsOn).size !== dependsOn.length) fail(`tasks[${index}].dependsOn contains duplicate ids`);
42:     if (dependsOn.includes(task.id)) fail(`task ${task.id} cannot depend on itself`);
43:     ids.add(task.id);
44:     tasks.push({ id: task.id, duration: task.duration, dependsOn });
45:   }
46: 
47:   for (const task of tasks) {
48:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) {
49:       if (!ids.has(dependency)) fail(`task ${task.id} depends on unknown task: ${dependency}`);
50:     }
51:   }
52:   return tasks;
53: }
54: 
55: function findCycle(tasks: Task[], byId: Map<string, Task>): string[] | undefined {
56:   const state = new Map<string, number>();
57:   const path: string[] = [];
58:   const visit = (id: string): string[] | undefined => {
59:     state.set(id, 1);
60:     path.push(id);
61:     for (const dependency of [...byId.get(id)!.dependsOn].sort()) {
62:       if (state.get(dependency) === 1) return [...path.slice(path.indexOf(dependency)), dependency];
63:       if (!state.has(dependency)) {
64:         const cycle = visit(dependency);
65:         if (cycle) return cycle;
66:       }
67:     }
68:     path.pop();
69:     state.set(id, 2);
70:   };
71:   for (const task of [...tasks].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))) {
72:     if (!state.has(task.id)) {
73:       const cycle = visit(task.id);
74:       if (cycle) return cycle;
75:     }
76:   }
77: }
78: 
79: function plan(tasks: Task[]) {
80:   const byId = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, task]));
81:   const cycle = findCycle(tasks, byId);
82:   if (cycle) fail(`dependency cycle: ${cycle.join(" -> ")}`);
83: 
84:   const children = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, [] as string[]]));
85:   const remaining = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, task.dependsOn.length]));
86:   for (const task of tasks) for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) children.get(dependency)!.push(task.id);
87:   for (const childIds of children.values()) childIds.sort();
88: 
89:   const ready = tasks.filter((task) => task.dependsOn.length === 0).map((task) => task.id).sort();
90:   const order: string[] = [];
91:   while (ready.length > 0) {
92:     const id = ready.shift()!;
93:     order.push(id);
94:     for (const child of children.get(id)!) {
95:       const count = remaining.get(child)! - 1;
96:       remaining.set(child, count);
97:       if (count === 0) {
98:         ready.push(child);
99:         ready.sort();
100:       }
101:     }
102:   }
103: 
104:   const earliest: Record<string, { start: number; finish: number }> = {};
105:   const paths = new Map<string, string[]>();
106:   const layers: string[][] = [];
107:   for (const id of order) {
108:     const task = byId.get(id)!;
109:     let start = 0;
110:     let predecessor: string | undefined;
111:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) {
112:       const finish = earliest[dependency].finish;
113:       if (finish > start || (finish === start && predecessor !== undefined && dependency.localeCompare(predecessor) < 0)) {
114:         start = finish;
115:         predecessor = dependency;
116:       }
117:     }
118:     earliest[id] = { start, finish: start + task.duration };
119:     const layer = task.dependsOn.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(...task.dependsOn.map((dependency) => layers.findIndex((group) => group.includes(dependency)) + 1));
120:     (layers[layer] ??= []).push(id);
121:     paths.set(id, predecessor ? [...paths.get(predecessor)!, id] : [id]);
122:   }
123:   for (const layer of layers) layer.sort();
124: 
125:   const totalDuration = Math.max(0, ...Object.values(earliest).map(({ finish }) => finish));
126:   const candidates = order.filter((id) => earliest[id].finish === totalDuration).map((id) => paths.get(id)!);
127:   candidates.sort((a, b) => a.join("\u0000").localeCompare(b.join("\u0000")));
128:   return { order, layers, earliest, totalDuration, criticalPath: candidates[0] ?? [] };
129: }

132: if (args.length !== 2 || args[0] !== "plan" || args[1].startsWith("-")) fail("usage: bun run src/cli.ts plan INPUT.json");
